name: Wardrowbe
description: Wardrowbe is a self-hosted, AI-powered wardrobe manager: photograph your clothes, auto-tag them with any OpenAI-compatible vision model, and get outfit recommendations based on weather and occasion.

notes.text: Set AI_BASE_URL, AI_VISION_MODEL and AI_TEXT_MODEL in /opt/wardrowbe/backend/.env to point at your Ollama or OpenAI-compatible endpoint, then restart wardrowbe-backend and wardrowbe-worker.
Ships with DEBUG dev login enabled, which accepts any email address. Configure an OIDC provider (OIDC_ISSUER_URL / OIDC_CLIENT_ID / OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET) and set DEBUG=false for real authentication.
